fields.why: Percentages of reinfection are compared across variant periods within age groups (and age groups within periods), which A read as comparison within levels of a third variable; but the brief's specific rule 'a series over time by group is a comparison, not stratification' fits a period-by-age-group table and weekly by-age series better, so B is preferred. Nothing is adjusted.

agreed_errors.why: CDC analyzed weekly aggregate counts reported by 18 jurisdictions; vital records and hospital records are only how jurisdictions ascertained deaths and hospitalizations, so 'registry' and 'record abstraction or interview' are not records analyzed (brief: list only the records analyzed). Low-stakes.

brief_issues: Need an explicit rule on whether period-vs-period contrasts within strata of a group variable (age, sex) count as stratified or fall under 'series over time by group'; readers split on this here and in mm7219a1.
